data.long_meaning: The meaning of Gadmon is recorded in name-lists as “God's mountain”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Gadmon expresses “God's mountain”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gadmon total 27, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_hebrew.name: גדמון
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word gad, meaning 'troop, band'.

in_greek.name: Gadmon
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει God's mountain
in_greek.long_meaning: Gadmon είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Hebrew words gad (troop) and mon (mountain). In the Bible, Gad is one of the twelve tribes of Israel. Gadmon can be interpreted as 'God's mountain troop'.

in_latin.name: Gadmon
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat God's mountain
in_latin.long_meaning: Gadmon est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Hebrew words gad (troop) and mon (mountain). In the Bible, Gad is one of the twelve tribes of Israel. Gadmon can be interpreted as 'God's mountain troop'.
